title: Spotify Q1 2026 update furnished on Form 6-K
excerpt: Q1 2026 ended with 761 million MAUs, 293 million Premium subscribers, EUR 4.533 billion revenue, a 33.0% gross margin, EUR 715 million operating income, and EUR 824 million free cash flow.
summary: Current primary financial update for the quarter ended 2026-03-31. Reported revenue grew 8% and 14% at constant currency, operating margin reached 15.8%, trailing-twelve-month free cash flow reached EUR 3.2 billion, and cash, restricted cash, and short-term investments totaled EUR 8.8 billion after repaying EUR 1.304 billion of exchangeable notes. Q2 guidance called for 778 million MAUs, 299 million Premium subscribers, EUR 4.8 billion revenue, 33.1% gross margin, and EUR 630 million operating income.
